ui_bugs.issue: At narrow viewports (~375-500px) the watchlist-change chip overflows outside the ribbon container (ribbon width 264, chip rendered at x=347) and visually overlaps the CHARTS button (open-chart-button). Confirmed via bounding-box overlap check at 375px and 480px; no overlap at 320px or 768+px. Root cause: the inner `flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0` div containing WATCHLIST label + select + add-btn + chip has no `flex-wrap`, and the chip has `shrink-0`, so at intermediate widths the chip is pushed past the parent's right edge and into the sibling CHARTS column.

rca of the issue: Bug 1 residual overlap RCA: WatchlistRibbon (Dashboard.jsx L234) is `flex ... flex-wrap` at the OUTER level, but the inner group `<div class='flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0'>` (L235) is NOT flex-wrap. Inside that inner group live WATCHLIST label + <select> (~174px) + add-btn (32px) + change chip (~42px). The chip has `shrink-0`. When the container falls into the ~250-320px range, the intrinsic min-content of the row exceeds the container, but because the container has `min-w-0`, the row can render beyond the container's right edge without triggering the outer flex-wrap. The chip therefore ends up at x=347 while the ribbon's right edge is at x=280. The sibling ChartDrawer sits in a `flex-1` column starting at ~x=292, so the chip's rendered rect (x=347-389) intersects the CHARTS button rect (x=292-359). Reproduction: viewport 375x800, navigate to /, watchlist selects auto-selects ARB or first symbol; the '-x.xx%' chip visibly overlaps the CHARTS button. Mitigation: either add `flex-wrap` to the inner div, move the chip out of the inner container so it becomes a wrapping sibling, or clip with `overflow-hidden` on the outer ribbon panel.
